results.deterministicQuickOutput: Call routing is made up of the following elements: - Call routing policy – Also called a voice routing policy. A container for PSTN usages, which can be assigned to a user or to multiple users. - PSTN usages – A container for voice routes and PSTN usages, which can be shared in different voice routing policies. - Voice routes – A number pattern and set of online PSTN gateways to use for calls where the calling number matches the pattern. - Online PSTN gateway - A pointer to an SBC that also stores the configuration that is applied when a call is placed through the SBC, such as forward P-Asserted-Identity (PAI) or Preferred Codecs; can be added to voice routes.
